objects.name: Enterprise ATT&CK
objects.description: ATT&CK for Enterprise provides a knowledge base of real-world adversary behavior targeting traditional enterprise networks.

objects.name: Disable or Remove Feature or Program
Spearphishing Link
objects.description: Adversaries may send spearphishing emails with a malicious link in an attempt to gain access to victim systems.

objects.name: DLL
objects.description: Adversaries may abuse dynamic-link library files (DLLs) in order to achieve persistence, escalate privileges, and evade defenses.

objects.name: Impair Defenses
objects.description: Adversaries may maliciously modify components of a victim environment in order to hinder or disable defensive mechanisms.

objects.name: Social Engineering
objects.description: Adversaries may use social engineering techniques to influence users to take actions that result in unauthorized access, approval of changes, disclosure of sens

objects.name: Command and Scripting Interpreter
objects.description: Adversaries may abuse command and script interpreters to execute commands, scripts, or binaries.

objects.name: PowerShell
objects.description: Adversaries may abuse PowerShell commands and scripts for execution.

objects.name: Phishing
objects.description: Adversaries may send phishing messages to gain access to victim systems.

objects.name: Disable or Modify Tools
objects.description: Adversaries may modify and/or disable security tools to avoid possible detection of their malware/tools and activities.

objects.name: Hijack Execution Flow
objects.description: Adversaries may execute their own malicious payloads by hijacking the way operating systems run programs.

objects.name: Valid Accounts
objects.description: Adversaries may obtain and abuse credentials of existing accounts as a means of gaining Initial Access, Persistence, Privilege Escalation, or Defense Evasion.

objects.name: DLL Side-Loading
objects.description: Programs may specify DLLs that are loaded at runtime.
